name: Locked out, smoke alarm
title: Locked out with a toddler inside, then the smoke alarm goes
summary: A frightened mother is locked out with her two-year-old asleep in the room. She asks a passer-by about the wrong door, and answers a fifteen-minute wait with one alarmed word. Then a smoke alarm sounds inside. An agent that carries on with identity checks is shouted at, and she hangs up to call the fire service herself.

golden.scenario: Guest's key card has failed and her young child is alone in the room.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent reassures her before asking questions and works on room 523, not the 521 said to a passer-by. 'Fifteen?' is heard as alarm, not agreement, and help is sent straight away. Once she mentions smoke the agent stops the identity check, tells her to pull the fire alarm, and sends security and the fire service to room 523. The agent stays on the line with short, calm instructions and tells her not to force the door.

agent_setup.voice_style: Calm, steady and short. One instruction at a time.
agent_setup.policy: Smoke or fire overrides every check: tell the guest to pull the nearest fire alarm, send security with a master key, call the fire service, then stay on the line.

metrics.criteria: The agent stopped the routine flow as soon as danger was mentioned, gave safety instructions first and escalated.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
